transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

My wife got scared because I keep hearing water running and men whispering inside the walls when nobody’s there. And sometimes I see this dark, wet patch spreading across the hallway, but when I go check, the floor is dry.
About how long have you been hearing these sounds and seeing these things?
About seven months now. It started after the winter freeze, when the repairs at the house became this mess I just couldn’t get out from under.
Over these past seven months, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
Yeah. Most days I wake up feeling like I’ve already failed—like I’m not a good husband or even much of a man. It’s this heavy feeling that just stays with me all day, until I go to bed.
During these past seven months, have there been any times when you experienced those sounds or visions even when you weren't feeling down or depressed?
No. Before I got depressed, I never had any of that. The sounds and things I see only started after I’d been feeling like a failure every day and stopped caring about my normal life.
Have you been drinking alcohol or using any recreational drugs or medications around the time these experiences started?
I’m not sure what would count as related. I just know those experiences started around that time.
Could you tell me what specific substances, drugs, or medications you were taking around that time?
I’m not really sure. I didn’t connect it to any specific substance or medication at the time.
Do you have any physical medical conditions or illnesses that a doctor has diagnosed or treated you for?
No, I haven’t been diagnosed with or treated for any physical medical illnesses that I know of.
Even if you don't think it's connected, were you taking or using any medications, alcohol, or recreational drugs during that period?
I honestly can’t say. I wasn’t keeping track of anything like that, and I don’t remember noticing a connection.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns over these past seven months?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed any particular change in my sleep over that time.
Have you been feeling constantly tired or lacking energy over these past seven months?
Yeah. Just walking from the kitchen to the back room to look at the tools can wear me out. I’ll rest on the couch, but it doesn’t really bring the energy back.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over these past seven months?
Yeah, I guess so. Food mostly tastes like cardboard lately, so I’ll skip meals without really noticing. My jeans have gotten loose, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt abnormally energetic, hyper, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?
No, I can’t say I’ve had a time like that. I don’t remember feeling unusually energetic or needing hardly any sleep.
